        STDDEV(pm.Margin) AS MarginStdDev
    FROM ProductMargins pm

        COUNT(*) AS ProductsSold,

    SELECT
        'ProductAttribute' AS AttributeType,
        CONCAT(
            pa.ProductAttributeId,
            ':',
            pav.Name

        COUNT(*) AS ProductsSold,
        AVG(pm.Margin) AS AvgMargin,
        STDDEV(pm.Margin) AS MarginStdDev

baseline_sql:

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m-01') AS revenue_month,
        SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPriceInclTax) AS total_revenue
    FROM OrderItem oi
    INNER JOIN `Order` o
        ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
    WHERE o.OrderStatusId IN (30, 40) -- Completed/Processing orders (adjust IDs per installation)
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m-01')
),
revenue_trend AS (
    SELECT
        revenue_month,
        total_revenue,
        AVG(total_revenue) OVER (
            ORDER BY revenue_month
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS moving_avg_3_months,
        LAG(total_revenue, 1) OVER (
            ORDER BY revenue_month
        ) AS previous_month_revenue
    FROM monthly_revenue
),
forecast AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_ADD(MAX(revenue_month), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),
            '%Y-%m-01'
        ) AS forecast_month,
        (
            AVG(moving_avg_3_months) +
            (
                AVG(total_revenue - previous_month_revenue)
            )
        ) AS predicted_revenue
    FROM revenue_trend
    WHERE previous_month_revenue IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    forecast_month,
    ROUND(predicted_revenue, 2) AS next_month_forecast_revenue
FROM forecast;
